value.rationale: The number of reversals before a rare uphill encounter is a natural path-complexity and energetic-activity observable absent from a mean escape time. Its nontrivial even-Poisson limit together with a deterministic square-root-rescaled first-passage time identifies which path mechanisms remain under near-balanced forcing. Exact critical-window dependence on the loading offset provides a reusable comparison for active-barrier passage.
